svg.title: Developer journey — the auth check names the missing piece and the right host — the auth check names each missing piece as the developer installs them
svg.text: Developer journey — the auth check names the missing
Scenario: the auth check names each missing piece as the developer installs them

g.text: Given a fresh toolbox checkout with none of its UI tools installed yet
A throwaway toolbox checkout before any setup: gum, glow and the glab CLI are all missing.
The card lists the three, none installed.
When the developer runs the auth check straight away
With nothing installed the check stops at the first tool, gum: "Required UI dependency
missing: gum", pointing at task dev:setup-environment. The test also checks the command
When the developer installs gum and re-runs the check
With gum in place the check moves on and stops at the next tool, glow: "Required UI
dependency missing: glow". The test also checks the command failed and printed that line.
When the developer adds glow and re-runs, leaving only the CLI missing
With gum and glow in place the check clears the UI tools and stops at the CLI: the "GitLab
CLI not found" box tells you to install glab. The test also checks the command failed and
When the developer installs the CLI and re-runs it in CI mode, still
Every tool is installed but no GitLab sign-in yet; CI=true takes the non-interactive path:
"GitLab authentication required", pointing at task glab:auth. The test also checks the
command failed and printed that line.
